title: A capable colleague, right in Slack
intro: Talk in threads, bring context along, and keep control of what gets posted.

features.title: Thread-first conversations
features.description: Mention the assistant once, then continue naturally in the thread. Configurable history backfill and durable conversations keep follow-ups in context.

features.title: More than a mention
features.description: Use configured reaction triggers, forward a Slack message to an assistant, or respond through interactive buttons. Messages arriving during work can steer the ongoing turn.

features.title: Search with your own visibility
features.description: Opt-in Slack search uses the speaking person’s stored user token, not the bot token. Missing credentials never fall back to a broader identity.

features.title: Deliberate publishing
features.description: Post messages, attach generated files, and batch notifications. Posting to other channels requires configured permission; posting as a person has a separate review and held-post pipeline.

features.title: A personal Slack presence
features.description: An explicitly authorized channel can update one designated user’s status and profile picture. This needs a user token with profile-write scope and is separate from search or posting.

title: Context that earns its place
intro: Keep facts, reusable procedures and shared reference material distinct.

features.title: Channel memory & shared knowledge
features.description: Recall durable facts by topic. Each channel has its own memory; shared account memory and knowledge bases cross boundaries only under their configured sharing rules.

features.title: Nightly memory maintenance
features.description: The dream pass revisits a channel’s conversations, consolidates repeated facts, captures missed learnings and archives forgotten entries. Journals and run logs make the pass inspectable.

features.title: Recent-conversation orientation
features.description: A rolling list of thread summaries gives fresh turns a view of recent activity. It is orientation context, not a replacement for durable memory.

features.title: Skills that agents can learn
features.description: Save and revise repeatable procedures in the Agent Skills format. Descriptions are discoverable in context; full instructions load on demand. Built-in guidance helps agents write useful skills.

features.title: Share a procedure, not a permission
features.description: Operators assign skill collections read-only or read-write. Agents can publish versioned skills to a library with permission; another channel reads and installs its own copy.

features.title: A searchable document shelf
features.description: Read attachments and extracted PDF text, file originals with metadata and checksums, then search and retrieve them through the document library. Operators can configure the library’s storage location.

title: From research to finished work
intro: Give each channel the tools it actually needs, rather than one global toolbox.

features.title: Web research & bounded downloads
features.description: Search with a configured provider, read web pages, and stage PDFs or binary downloads. Credential-free fetching checks redirects and blocks private network addresses by default.

features.title: Workspace files without a shell
features.description: Read, write, edit, list and search files; manage workspace files without bash. Save actual tool results directly to a workspace file instead of reconstructing long responses.

features.title: Lists, state & SQLite
features.description: Keep typed channel lists, a revisioned structured state object, and workspace SQLite databases. Use these for trackers and durable work data rather than hiding everything in chat.

features.title: Images, charts & slide decks
features.description: Inspect images, generate images with a configured provider, produce charts, and build HTML slide decks that can be attached in Slack. Availability depends on enabled tools and provider credentials.

features.title: MCP connectors & OAuth
features.description: Connect remote HTTP or local stdio MCP services. A catalogue entry does not enable access: assign connectors to channels, filter exposed tools, and authorize OAuth where required.

features.title: Reviewed command-line tools
features.description: Expose selected CLI operations through exec with positional-only argument wildcards, or explicitly opt a trusted executable into all arguments including flags with allowAllArgs. Whole-CLI trust includes that executable’s execution capabilities. A shared CLI registry stays opt-in per channel; shared-script restrictions remain separate.

features.title: Opt-in browser automation
features.description: The harness image bundles Playwright CLI and Chromium. A trusted QA channel can receive a restrictive exec command for navigation, inspection and screenshots; enabling a browser is a network-capable action.

features.title: Ask for a capability
features.description: Discover safe catalogue metadata and request connectors or CLI tools through an admin approval lifecycle. New capabilities need reviewed provisioning and enablement, not autonomous installation.

title: Useful even between conversations
intro: Schedule follow-ups, monitor quietly, and make background work visible.

features.title: One-off & recurring work
features.description: Create, update and cancel cron schedules or one-time tasks. One-off check-backs can return to their originating thread. Timezones, minimum intervals and opt-in cron catch-up keep timing explicit.

features.title: Quiet channel heartbeats
features.description: Maintain an opt-in monitoring prompt and interval per channel. Heartbeats use existing channel tools, skip missed or overlapping ticks, and post only through explicit notification tools. Recurring usage is tracked separately.

features.title: Jobs & task tracking
features.description: Track substantive work with statuses and reference links. Durable jobs persist progress and checkpoints; scheduled run ledgers record successful, failed and interrupted outcomes.

features.title: Gated task workflows
features.description: Declare an ordered pipeline with plain-language acceptance gates. Workers submit output; the parent independently decides each gate and explicitly starts the next step. Definitions and rejected work can be corrected with audit history.

features.title: Subagents & task transfer
features.description: Delegate focused work to configured roles with model and approval policies. Role tools are intersected with the channel’s permissions. Explicit channel-to-channel transfer returns completion to the source.

title: An issue-to-PR software factory
intro: A durable engineering pipeline with independent review and bounded autonomy.

features.title: Triage → code → review
features.description: Configured agent teams carry GitHub issues through implementation and independent review. Workflow stages, retries and review rounds survive restarts and stay linked to the issue and pull request. Operators can opt into an explicit Git author name and email for future coder commits, including rework; existing history is unchanged.

features.title: Trusted issue intake & Jira tracking
features.description: Opt-in intake watches configured repositories and holds untrusted authors for release. Jira Cloud factories can use ACLI for work tracking while keeping code and PRs on GitHub.

features.title: Review-bound merge gates
features.description: Cautious, balanced and autonomous policies bound automation. Risk, sensitive paths, required checks and the exact reviewed commit gate merging; human approvals are enforced by runtime identity, not comment text.

features.title: Return feedback & recover a run
features.description: Request changes on a factory PR to return it through implementation and review. Authorized operators can answer questions, retry failed stages or abort. Conflict repair stays on the existing branch and needs fresh review.

features.title: Controlled deployment & integrations
features.description: Choose an optional approval-gated Cloudflare deployer or opt into read-only GitHub Actions monitoring for a configured workflow and exact merged commit. Monitoring defaults to a 30-minute deadline and never triggers workflows or deploys. The opt-in factory MCP adapter exposes scoped operations; writes need console actions enabled and appropriate access protection.

title: See what your assistants are doing
intro: An optional operator console, separate from this public website.

features.title: Live conversations & activity
features.description: Browse the cross-channel activity feed, thread tree, transcripts and streamed progress. A timeline separates parent and subagent work. Direct-message content is withheld from monitoring views.

features.title: Tools, context & usage visibility
features.description: Inspect models, context-window use, tokens and reported cost, including usage by activity. See execution boundaries, enabled tools, connector status, skills, state, memory, schedules, approvals and recovery holds.

features.title: An unobtrusive usage indicator
features.description: Optionally show account-wide recorded token and cost totals for rolling one-hour and 24-hour windows in one public channel’s topic. Human-written topics are left untouched; the bot needs a specific Slack topic-write scope.

features.title: Factory dashboard & run controls
features.description: See issues, PRs, merges and detailed workflow attempts. Optional console actions allow selected run controls and list editing; they do not replace Slack merge authorization.

features.title: Workspace & database inspection
features.description: Browse workspace metadata and bounded read-only SQLite snapshots through the console’s access boundary. Symlinks are not followed and direct-message workspaces are withheld.

features.title: Share generated browser artifacts
features.description: Optionally serve only each channel’s artifacts folder with stable links. Artifacts run in an opaque sandboxed origin; normal workspace files, private attachments and transcripts are not published through artifact hosting.

features.title: Configuration & secret administration
features.description: Edit configuration with validation, backups and reload warnings. Basic settings includes multiline preferences and all five rolling thread-summary settings at global-default and existing-channel scope, with individual overrides and inheritance. Summaries are orientation, not durable memory. Basic settings also edits the default scheduling timezone (unset: UTC), without retiming existing tasks; timer changes may require restart. Raw YAML shares the same draft. Secret administration is write-only with supervised restart; optional scoped configurator roles apply separate runtime-enforced edit policies.

features.title: Desktop, mobile & installable
features.description: The console supports light and dark themes and an installable app shell. Live API data is never cached for offline use; Cloudflare Access-protected shells are not cached either.

title: Your data. Explicit boundaries.
intro: Designed for a trusted home or small-team installation, not hostile multi-tenancy.

features.title: Per-channel isolation
features.description: Each channel has its own workspace, memory, tools, skills and connectors. File tools resolve real paths against allowed roots. Sharing, cross-channel memory reads and narrow workspace symlink targets are explicit operator choices.

features.title: Expiring permission grants
features.description: Tools and model access are allowlisted per channel. Agents can request configured capabilities with human approval and bounded grant durations; a grant is not a new account-wide permission.

features.title: Explicit execution boundaries
features.description: Choose host bash, Docker, opt-in Kiri 0.2.1+ via its native CLI, or Apple Containers on supported macOS. Container lifecycles retain isolated checkouts, enforce configured resources and protect active work. Kiri requires runtime setup and host smoke testing; interrupted executions are conservatively retained until stopped. Host bash is not a filesystem jail.

features.title: Choose & switch models
features.description: Use configured API providers, supported subscription OAuth, or local OpenAI-compatible servers. Agents can list and switch allowed models; credentials are account-level and thread model choices persist.

features.title: Scoped credentials & secret backends
features.description: Layer global and per-channel secrets without putting values in prompts. Optional macOS Keychain and OpenBao backends support managed credentials; subagent GitHub token overrides separate role identities.

features.title: Durable conversations & recovery
features.description: Per-channel SQLite conversation stores retain work across restarts. Recovery rechecks current user, tool and model access; interrupted external effects are reported rather than blindly repeated. Slack delivery reconciles previously sent replies.

features.title: Self-host, back up & diagnose
features.description: Run on a Raspberry Pi, Docker or a supported native host using Node 22.19+. Back up runtime data with the supported backup procedure. Doctor checks, health/status endpoints, usage records and limitation reporting help operators diagnose problems.

features.title: Protect the operator surface
features.description: The console has no built-in login by default. Opt-in Cloudflare Access JWT validation checks sessions server-side; otherwise use an authenticated proxy or private network. A tunnel alone is not authentication.
